correctness.rationale: Exact Irwin--Hall volume and polar facet-pyramid formulas are proved with explicit disjointness; the density recurrence establishes strict unimodality and odd-dimensional small-width monotonicity, even-dimensional derivatives follow from exact zero-sum facet counts. The complete 3D profile is verified by exact differentiation, a strictly decreasing quartic derivative numerator on (1,3), a positive-factor minimum gap and a nonnegative Bernstein certificate for the global upper bound. Standalone checker passes 15 independent numerical hull-volume pairs and algebraic identities, while finite checks are not substituted for infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The Mahler volume product is a standard affine-invariant measure, and centrally symmetric slices of cubes are a canonical geometric degeneration. A rigorous parity reversal at a singular boundary of the body family, paired with a complete sharp 3D phase portrait (two distinct minimizers, one local peak and a nonattained supremum) is a motivated classification and an exact benchmark for Mahler stability and geometry of slab cuts. The value is not based merely on code or on repackaging the known 3D minimum.
